Title: HCT116
Characteristics: cell line: HCT116 | cell type: Colorectal carcinoma-derived cells
Growth: Standard growth protocol in McCoy (HCT116, RKO) or DMEM media (HKE3), supplemented with 10 % FBS. Cells were split 1:5 every third or fourth day.
Extraction: Rneasy Plus Mini Kit (Qiagen), as per manufacturer's instructions. All samples had a RIN value of 10, according to analysis on the Agilent 2100 BioAnalyzer. | TruSeq mRNA kit (Illumina), 200 ng per sample
Processing: Alignment of reads using STAR (v2.5.1b) | Variant calling as per GATK's Best Practice workflow (v3.5.0, https://www.broadinstitute.org/gatk/guide/article?id=3891, December 2015) | Annotation using SnpEff/SnpSift (v4.2) | In-house Python and R scripts, as described in the corresponding article and R Markdown document. | Genome_build: GRCh37 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: .txt
